title: Emotibot Completes Series D2 from Jinpu, Jinku, Jiangsu Culture & Peers — ChatGPT-Class Products Live
summary: On Feb 27, 2023, NLP AI vendor Emotibot / Zhujian Intelligence (竹间智能) announced year-end Series D2 from Jinpu Investment, Jinku Capital, Jiangsu Culture Investment, Juenci Capital et al. Cumulative 7 rounds; prior shareholders Ecovacs, Yunhui, BOCI…
author: Unique Research
html:
Unique Research · Company / funding · March 13, 2023

On Feb 27, 2023, NLP AI vendor Emotibot / Zhujian Intelligence (竹间智能) announced year-end Series D2 from Jinpu Investment, Jinku Capital, Jiangsu Culture Investment, Juenci Capital et al. Cumulative 7 rounds; prior shareholders Ecovacs, Yunhui, BOCI…

Founded 2015 by Jian Renxian (ex-VP, Microsoft Asia Internet Engineering Institute) — NLP, affective computing, DL, knowledge eng, text. Emotion-aware brain-like dialogue robots that read/see/hear/remember and self-learn preferences (trips, hotels…). Six platforms: Bot Factory²² conversational AI, Gemini²² knowledge eng, AICC+²², NLP²², Scorpio²² AutoML, WFEA²² workflow automation — finance / enterprise / healthcare / manufacturing / smart devices / government.

Now shipping ChatGPT-class AIGC products; next round planned to fuse LLMs + AIGC into a dual-engine (large+small models), refresh product/service modes, and push overseas as a global NLP vendor. Writing tools Magic Writer / Wendroid / Inspiration Flash; enterprise Gemini GPT line (KKBot, ChatSearch, AI coach, employee assistant). 2022 full PLG shift. Conversational AI platform passed CAICT Trusted AI 4+ grade. 500+ large enterprise clients; 100+ ecosystem partners; standardized OP/SaaS live across finance/manufacturing/retail/pharma/gov.

— END —
